name: Common Rose-mallow
desc: Common Rose-mallow (Hibiscus moscheutos): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 9 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Muenchhusia moscheutos, the rose mallow, swamp rose-mallow, crimsoneyed rosemallow, or eastern rosemallow, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae.
